title: A--Data Coordinating Center for BPCA
agency: HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, DEPARTMENT OF.NATIONAL INSTITUTES OF HEALTH.NATIONAL INSTITUTES OF HEALTH NICHD
description_text: Data Coordinating Center (DCC) to provide clinical data management, statistical analysis, regulatory support, and data quality oversight for pediatric clinical trials conducted under the BPCA program to support FDA regulatory submissions and pediatric drug development research.
